question: If ₹1,875 becomes ₹2,625 in 4 years, what will ₹24,000 become at the end of 9 years at the same rate of interest, under simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 4 years = 2625 − 1875 = ₹750

Rate % = (750 × 100) ÷ (1875 × 4) = 10%

Interest on ₹24000 for 9 years at 10% = (24000 × 10 × 9) ÷ 100 = ₹21600

Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 24000 + 21600 = ₹45600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal P₁ = ₹1875, Amount A₁ = ₹2625, Time T₁ = 4 years

Principal P₂ = ₹24000, Time T₂ = 9 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9b99a588e039e456d7642c8c4c68ca8ad042408658618ec3a449ebc455f0c63.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = A₁ − P₁ = 2625 − 1875 = ₹750

⇒ R = (SI₁ × 100) ÷ (P₁ × T₁)

⇒ R = (750 × 100) ÷ (1875 × 4) = 75000 ÷ 7500 = 10%

⇒ SI₂ = (P₂ × R × T₂) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = (24000 × 10 × 9) ÷ 100 = ₹21600

⇒ A₂ = P₂ + SI₂

⇒ A₂ = 24000 + 21600 = ₹45600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the principal remains constant throughout the entire period, whereas in Compound Interest, the principal periodically increases as the generated interest is added to it.

Direct Proportion in Simple Interest

For a fixed principal amount and rate of interest, the total Simple Interest earned is directly proportional to the elapsed time period.
